title: A charm to protect men and cattle

verses.t: Entrust me, Visvajit, to Trāyamānā. Guard, Trāyamānā, all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.
To Visvajit entrust me, Trāyamānā. O Visvajit, guard all our men, etc.
To Visvajit entrust me, O Kalyāni. Guard, O Kalyāni, all our men, etc.
To Sarvavid entrust me, O Kalyāni. O Sarvavid, guard all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.
